findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/frozen-claim-drift-smoke.ts:294-332 (CHK-004:adversarial:0) — the must-intent claims the smoke is deterministic/offline so it cannot flake in CI, but its recorded verificationEvidence reuses the IDENTICAL selector string frozen-claim-drift-smoke: PASS already bound to CHK-004:happy:0 (checklist.json). No assertion in the smoke distinctly verifies determinism/offline-ness (e.g. running the smoke twice and diffing outputDigest, or asserting no network/child_process import) — the selector is a rubber-stamp duplicate, not a distinguishing check for this specific must-intent.

packages/main/src/handlers/frozen-claim-drift-check.ts:144-146 — CHK-003:happy:0 must-intent explicitly promises "...for a drifted story and a clean report for a clean story", but the only verificationEvidence (frozen-claim-drift-smoke.ts:137-231) calls buildDriftReport directly on in-memory fixtures that always include a drifted item; it never exercises the zero-advisory clean branch (the handlers text-mode "0 drifted, 0 legacy-unbound -- clean" string) nor the actual registered frozen_claim_drift_check --storyId CLI entry point end-to-end (resolveStoryGitCwd + currentStoryFilesHash + store.readChecklist + JSON/text serialization). Manually running node bin/lattice.js frozen_claim_drift_check confirms the real command works, but no re-runnable mechanical evidence covers that path or the clean-story branch — half of a compound must-intent is unverified.

missing: packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts:286-306 captureUserSeesSnapshot (the real production hook wired into checklist_update at the status->done transition, lines 1381-1386) is exercised by ZERO automated tests. frozen-claim-drift-smoke.ts and every CHK-002 verificationEvidence row only unit-test the pure detectDrift/buildDriftReport Fns against hand-constructed FrozenClaimSnapshot fixtures -- none of them ever invoke checklist_update or the real captureUserSeesSnapshot/evidenceHashes wiring. CHK-002s own verificationIntent explicitly specified type=cli for happy/edge/adversarial (e.g. CHK-002:happy:0 after userSees is snapshotted at status=done...), but the recorded evidence substitutes the same offline pure-Fn smoke script (kind:integration_test) instead of a real CLI-driven test. I manually verified via an isolated scratch repo (spawnSync against dist/cli.js) that the real hook currently behaves correctly (captures on first done, immutable-once on re-persist), so there is no live bug today -- but a future refactor of the status-transition block in checklist.ts (e.g. reordering the oldStatus capture, or the userSees vs status write order) could silently break snapshot capture or the immutable-once guarantee with no automated test catching it.

packages/main/src/cli/activity-policy.ts:1-84 (READ_ONLY_COMMANDS) — frozen_claim_drift_check is registered as strictly read-only in every OTHER map (command-policy.ts ownershipClass=readOnly/destructiveRisk=none, process-fact-levels.ts level=L0 rationale="Writes no files/evidence, mutates nothing", config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS comment="writes nothing", and its own handler header comment) but is MISSING from activity-policy.ts READ_ONLY_COMMANDS, the set cli-engine.ts isReadOnlyCommand()/shouldWriteActivityLog()/writeCodexProcessEvent() consult to decide whether to append a process event. Reproduced: LATTICE_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex node bin/lattice.js frozen_claim_drift_check storyId=B-2296 appends a codex_cli entry to .lattice/story/actives/B-2296/process-events.jsonl (git status shows the file dirtied) — a real story-metadata mutation for a command documented and classified everywhere else as never mutating anything. Sibling read-only, all-phase diagnostic commands added alongside similar storyFilesHash-drift features (acceptance_topology_check, pre_review_check_read, topology_critic_receipt_check, checklist_get) ARE all present in this set. Fix: add frozen_claim_drift_check to READ_ONLY_COMMANDS in packages/main/src/cli/activity-policy.ts.
findings.resolvedReason: Added frozen_claim_drift_check to READ_ONLY_COMMANDS in packages/main/src/cli/activity-policy.ts (commit 01df7748); the command no longer appends a process-event under LATTICE_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex, matching command-policy/process-fact-levels/config classification.
